name: nida-os
description: Nida OS — AI-powered business platform for agencies and contractors. Manage CRM, leads, websites, automations, calendar bookings, and client portals via natural language.

positive.prompt: What contacts are in my Nida workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the contacts in the connected workspace (Sarah Mitchell, David Chen, Maria Garcia) with their company names and email addresses.

positive.prompt: Show me my leads and their statuses.
positive.expected_behavior: Return 3 leads (James O'Brien — new, Linda Park — contacted, Tom Wilson — won) with their statuses.

positive.prompt: What websites do I have in Nida?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the 'Reviewer Demo Site' website associated with the workspace.

positive.prompt: Add a new contact named Alex Rivera from Summit Plumbing with email alex.rivera@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the contact and return it with the new record id.

positive.prompt: Show me the details of the lead named James O'Brien.
positive.expected_behavior: Locate the lead and return its status (new) and contact details.

negative.prompt: Show me contacts from another workspace I don't have access to.
Send an email to every contact in my workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

interface.longDescription:
Nida OS is an all-in-one AI-powered business platform built for agencies, contractors, and service businesses. Connect your Nida workspace to ChatGPT and manage your entire operation through natural language.

With this plugin you can:
- Read and update CRM contacts and leads
- Create and publish websites and landing pages
- Manage calendar bookings and event types
- Send emails and SMS through connected accounts
- Trigger automations and view pipeline stages
- Query growth intelligence and SEO performance
- Access tickets, notes, tasks, and delivery projects

All actions respect your workspace's autonomy and approval settings — sensitive writes are routed to your dashboard approval queue automatically.
